verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Crossmint publishing a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe returned 404 on every standard OpenAPI/Swagger path. The interactive API reference pages and the llms.txt/AI-assistant docs ingestion are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API spec download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
